Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id as chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL829152. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join activities to molecule_dictionary via molregno and to compound_structures via molregno. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Return all matching rows without deduplication.
